faqs.a:
An application to install, operate and maintain a community antenna television system
               shall be made by the applicant, or his duly designated agent, to the city council.
               Such application shall contain the following information:
(1)
The name and address of the applicant, and should the applicant be a corporation,
                  the names and addresses of all officers and directors of such corporation.
(2)
An outline of the general construction and operating plans of the applicant.
(3)
A schedule of rates and charges for all services.
(4)
A proposed schedule for the construction of the system and the commencement of service.
(Code 1960, § 7A-2; Code 1981, § 9-3)
